title: SUPERVISOR DE VENDAS/LOJA
description:
Sobre Nós:

A Premix atua há mais de 46 anos no mercado, oferecendo soluções em nutrição integradas para a pecuária nacional.

O propósito da empresa é nutrir a cadeia produtiva do agronegócio de forma sustentável e inovadora, criando prosperidade e respeitando o planeta em que vivemos, por meio de inovação, relacionamento e conhecimento compartilhado.

Oferece consultoria técnica especializada, seja presencialmente, nas propriedades de seus clientes, ou através do serviço Técnico Digital, que pode ser acessado através do site da empresa.

Com moderna estrutura de produção e distribuição, possui presença onde a pecuária está, com fábricas próprias em Patrocínio Paulista (SP), Presidente Prudente (SP), Araguaína (TO), Cuiabá (MT) e Anápolis, (GO), além de centros de distribuição em Maringá (PR), Campo Grande (MS), Linhares (ES), Xinguara (PA), Bataguassu (MS), Estreito (MA), Gurupi (TO) e Vilhena (RO), investindo constantemente em inovação e desenvolvimento tecnológico de novos produtos, com pesquisas e parcerias com as mais renomadas instituições de ensino do Brasil.

“Venha juntar-se ao nosso time que, há 46 anos, abre as porteiras da pecuária no Brasil.”

Os Desafios que te esperam são:

  • Responsável por gerenciar as atividades de representantes comerciais;
  • Gerir uma equipe de representantes-consultores internos de vendas e equipe administrativa;
  • Responsável pela receita gerada pela equipe bem como cumprimento das metas mensais de vendas;
  • Supervisionar a administração de políticas e programas de vendas para cumprir metas de vendas e lucros do território;
  • Analisar o comportamento do mercado em relação às vendas dos produtos e fundamentadas em informações do BI, a fim de demonstrar comportamento das vendas de sua região;
  • Contribuir nas negociações de vendas junto à equipe de RCs nos clientes chaves da supervisão;
  • Recrutar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe de RCs constantemente com foco nos pilares e aumento da capilaridade da empresa;
  • Supervisionar rotinas administrativas do CD Gurupi.

Não Pode Faltar Neste Profissional Que Buscamos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Zootecnia, Veterinária ou Agronomia;
  • Experiência com negociação e vendas;
  • Conhecimento no pacote Office Avançado;
  • Boa capacidade de gestão de crises e resolução de problemas;
  • Habilidades de negociação e persuasão;
  • Residir em Gurupi/TO;
  • MBA - será um diferencial.

Nossos Benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida em grupo;
  • Carro e celular fornecidos pela empresa.

Informações Adicionais:

  • Modelo de trabalho: presencial;
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ – prazo indeterminado;
  • Horário de trabalho: Sem jornada fixa;
  • Local: CD Gurupi.

title: Logistics Manager (Ecommerce Last Mile )
description:
Job Responsibilities

  • Last Mile Operations Management: Oversee last mile logistics, ensuring timely and cost-efficient parcel distribution through partner carriers. Monitor daily operations, investigate anomalies, and implement corrective actions to maintain service excellence.
  • Performance Management: Define and track KPIs such as on-time delivery, delivery success rate, and transit times. Develop dashboards and reports to provide data-driven insights to internal stakeholders and senior management.
  • Supplier Coordination: Manage relationships with last mile carriers, ensuring service levels meet company standards. Conduct regular meetings, align volume forecasts, and monitor SLAs to maintain high performance.
  • Operational Standardization: Establish and document best practices for last mile logistics. Define roles, responsibilities, and performance management models to ensure consistency across operations.
  • Process Optimization: Identify and implement improvements in delivery operations. Benchmark industry best practices and develop initiatives to enhance efficiency, capacity, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Incident Resolution & Continuous Improvement: Lead proactive issue resolution, ensuring smooth communication between teams and timely escalation of critical cases. Implement feedback loops to drive continuous operational improvements.
  • Strategic Network Planning: Support the development of last mile network strategies, aligning logistics infrastructure with business growth plans and cost optimization goals.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in last mile logistics operations, preferably in e-commerce and/or express logistics.
  • Operational Expertise: Strong understanding of last mile logistics, carrier coordination, and performance management.
  • Experience with Next-Day and Second-Day Delivery: Knowledge of express delivery models and their operational challenges.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to analyze KPIs, identify risks, and drive process improvements through data insights.
  • Hands-on Approach: Willingness to visit field operations, engage with carriers, and ensure seamless execution.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Quick analytical thinking to address operational challenges and implement preventive measures.
  • Project Management: Experience in leading and executing logistics projects, working cross-functionally to achieve business goals.
  • Mandatory fluency in Portuguese and English. Spanish and Mandarin are a plus.

CAREERS AT SHEIN

We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

We Engage with Global Cultures

Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: Accounts Receivable Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Credit & Collections Analyst to join our finance team. This role is ideal for professionals with a strong background in credit analysis, collections, and financial risk management who are passionate about driving transformation and automation within the finance function.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and update customer account information in ERP systems based on documentation and internal controls.
  • Monitor and analyze credit limits and manage credit insurance processes.
  • Communicate with credit insurers to negotiate and secure approval for customer limits.
  • Foster strong client relationships through direct contact and collaboration with the sales team.
  • Analyze and process credit-hold orders for timely release and billing.
  • Monitor customer credit risk profiles and daily financial exposure.
  • Track and report on key metrics such as DSO, delinquency, and collections performance.
  • Manage and review customer deductions and rebates.
  • Develop and maintain financial and performance dashboards using Excel and Power BI.
  • Support both internal and external audit processes with relevant documentation.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and implement solutions using tools such as Power Automate, VBA, macros, and AI technologies.
  • Assist in strategic projects aimed at process improvement and digital transformation within the credit & collections function.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Credit and Collections;
  • Advanced Excel skills (including pivot tables, advanced formulas, and dashboards);
  • Knowledge of AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT), Power BI, dashboards, and data analytics;
  • Experience in financial statement and income statement (P&L) analysis;
  • Advanced English proficiency;

title: Medical Science Liaison - Brazil
description:
Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company with global Headquarters based in San Diego, California developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully-integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.

Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be in Brazil.

MSL is a field-based scientific expert focused on developing and maintaining peer-to-peer relationships with key medical experts and healthcare professionals. This role will primarily support the company Acromegaly program. The MSL will collaborate with physicians and other medical experts to support trial enrollment, provide programming and protocol training and ensure that health care professionals have the most up to date information as the clinical development programs mature and conduit for external scientific engagement and internal strategic alignment, contributing to evidence generation, medical education, and cross-functional support. The MSL supports the generation of scientific knowledge through facilitation of investigator-initiated trials and publications.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

  • Develop and maintain peer-to-peer collaborations and relationships with KOLs community
  • Provide scientific support for pre-launch initiatives, including medical congresses, advisory boards, and educational events.
  • Tactical delivery of programs according to established objectives and serves as a resource for education and dissemination of pertinent, clear, and balanced medical-scientific information to internal audiences (Marketing, Medical Affairs, Research & Development and Sales) and external audiences (healthcare professionals, consumers, patient organizations, distributors, etc.)
  • Support clinical development initiatives including site identification, trial recruitment, registry, and presentation of final approved data
  • Collaborating with physicians on medical affairs initiatives including publications, advisory boards, medical education opportunities, training, and speaker development
  • Serve as scientific peer-to-peer resource to external disease experts and internal stakeholders
  • Support the medical community with up-to-date medical information, robust disease expertise, and product information
  • Communicate clinical insights on new data to the company Medical Affairs and to inform medical strategy for the therapeutic area
  • Train internal stakeholders on key scientific and medical topics in relevant therapeutic areas.
  • Develop an understanding of the regional landscape including specialties involved in care of patients •
  • Maintain effective and appropriate communication among internal stakeholders while maintaining full compliance with relevant requirements
  • Generate tactical regional plans to provide needs based, value-added support of the medical and scientific community in-line with company goals
  • Uses systems to strategically map, identify, profile and prioritize thought leaders in line with the medical plan and goals
  • Maintain accurate reporting and documentation of MSL activities.

Education:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, pharmacy, or other medical related disciplines.
  • Advanced degree preferred.

Requirements:

  • 12 years of professional experience,
  • At least 5 years of experience in Medical Affairs or Medical Science roles.
  • Robust and current clinical development experience supporting drugs to treat rare diseases; prior endocrinology diseases experience, preferred.
  • MSL and/or strong scientific experience in endocrinology, and specifically growth hormone-related disorders, preferred.
  • Pre-launch experience is highly preferred.
  • Excellent written, oral, communication, leadership and organizational skills.
  • Solid interpersonal and communication skills; demonstrated relationship builder. Ability to work well across teams to communicate relevant insights and drive strategy.
  • Candidates must understand compliance considerations and demonstrate ability to work compliantly in a field-based role, within the medical organization, as well as across the commercial organization.

Travel:

Up to 70%. Willingness to travel extensively across the region, including nights/weekends.

description:
A Indigo é uma empresa multinacional que tem por propósito transformar o agronegócio através do nosso portfólio de produtos biológicos, programas de crédito de carbono e soluções de crédito agricola.

Queremos ser o parceiro número um dos nossos clientes, cuidando de suas produções agrícolas, garantindo sustentabilidade ao meio ambiente, além de contribuir para uma alimentação mundial cada vez mais saudável.

É questionando que evoluímos.

O que faz um(a) Representante Técnico de Vendas em nosso time?

Nosso time de RTVs desempenham um papel fundamental na promoção e venda do portfólio Indigo junto aos nossos clientes, além de ser figura chave no posicionamento da empresa em sua região de atuação (Diamantino e/ou Tangará da Serra). É de sua responsabilidade fornecer suporte técnico especializado, identificando necessidades dos clientes e oferecendo soluções que atendam às suas demandas.

Considerando suas atividades, podemos destacar:

Desenvolvimento de Clientes - Identificar e prospectar novos clientes em sua área de atuação, cultivando relacionamentos sólidos e duradouros.

Assessoria Técnica - Fornecer suporte técnico especializado aos clientes, incluindo orientações sobre o uso adequado do portfólio Indigo, manejo de culturas, entre outros.

Vendas e Negociação - Gerenciar o ciclo de vendas completo, desde a prospecção inicial até o fechamento do negócio, utilizando técnicas de negociação eficazes para garantir a satisfação do cliente e atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas.

Análise de Mercado - Monitorar as tendências do mercado, identificar oportunidades de negócio e realizar análises competitivas para desenvolver estratégias de vendas eficientes.

Treinamento e Capacitação - Conduzir treinamentos técnicos para clientes, garantindo o correto entendimento do portfólio Indigo.

Gestão de Território - Gerenciar eficientemente o território de vendas atribuído, planejando visitas aos clientes, otimizando rotas e maximizando o tempo dedicado às atividades de vendas.

Relacionamento com Áreas Parceiras Indigo - Colaborar com outras equipes internas, como marketing, pesquisa e desenvolvimento, logística, crédito e atendimento ao cliente, para garantir uma abordagem integrada e eficaz no atendimento às demandas dos clientes.

  • Formação acadêmica em Agronomia, Engenharia Agrícola, ou áreas relacionadas. Pós-graduação ou cursos específicos na área serão considerados diferenciais.
  • Experiência prévia em vendas técnicas para o mercado agro, preferencialmente com conhecimento em biológicos.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, com capacidade para construir relacionamentos de confiança com clientes e colaboradores internos.
  • Capacidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma, gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e tomar decisões assertivas em um ambiente dinâmico e competitivo.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes dentro da região de atuação, bem como participação em eventos e feiras do setor.

Venha fazer parte desse time que está transformando a agricultura!

title: Oliver Wyman - Jr Talent Manager - Sao Paulo
description:
Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in 70 cities across 30 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. Our 7,000 professionals help clients optimize their business, improve their operations and risk profile, and accelerate their organizational performance to seize the most attractive opportunities. Oliver Wyman’s thought leadership is evident in our agenda-setting books, white papers, research reports, and articles in the business press. Our clients are the CEOs and executive teams of the top Global 1000 companies.

Visit our website for more details about Oliver Wyman:

Job Overview:

Oliver Wyman is seeking a Jr Talent Manager to manage a population of ~60 consultants across Oliver Wyman’s offices and Practices. This role will be responsible for their scheduling and performance management, and for personally engaging with the consultants in your group to know and understand their strengths, development objectives, personal preferences and career goals. You will also interact with Partners and Talent Managers in other parts of the business to assemble consulting teams and to remediate any issues.

The successful Jr Talent Manager will be able to proactively, delicately and empathetically balance the needs of the business alongside the preferences, career goals and development needs of the consultant to deliver appropriate staffing and talent management outcomes. You will work in a tight knit team against demanding timelines to help deliver Oliver Wyman’s business model.

This is a hybrid role that requires 3 days per week in the office. There is no option to be fully remote.

Key Responsibilities:

Talent Management:

  • Use the performance management process as a basis for engaging own consultants on development needs and areas for training
  • Develop relationships with each consultant and begin to be seen as a trusted advisor
  • Assist in directing consultants towards resources for career advice
  • Assist the consultants in escalating employee relations issues or questions around general Human Capital operations
  • Monitor for work-life-quality issues and escalate when needed
  • Collaborate with Human Capital Manager on managing the pyramid, training, onboarding, performance improvement initiatives

Project Staffing:

  • Understand at a high-level the nuances of the type of work / roles being filled
  • Liaise with project team leaders to understand staffing needs in your area
  • For assigned projects, collect all relevant details from Partners and Practice Group TMs on projects to be staffed
  • Anticipate capacity issues and manage consultants' and Partner expectations accordingly
  • Communicate staffing outcomes to consultants under your TM purview in an empathetic manner
  • Track mobility issues, holidays, trainings, background checks and other ad-hoc staffing enabling tasks
  • Ensure consultant files (bio slides, project reviews, technical skills, etc) are kept current and readily available for project proposals
  • Track your consultant’s performance, skills and development needs to help guide their growth and progression within OW

Consultant Development and Performance Management:

  • Understand the performance management framework and competency model and how it applies to own consultant's situations
  • Coordinate with the Learning and Development team on appropriate training for your consultants
  • Read all performance appraisals and follow-up any issues / performance flags with project team and manager
  • Coordinate, attend and contribute to annual Career Review meetings in for own consultant populations

Data, analysis and reporting:

  • Review weekly utilization reports, cross reference with the systems to ensure latest information is captured
  • Assist with the assembly of the project pipeline and consultant availability reports
  • Help to prepare documents and exhibits for various senior leadership meetings (using Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Assist with the analysis of performance outcome results
  • Ad hoc analyses and reporting as needed
  • Demonstrate capability in using enterprise resource management tools and performance systems
  • Maintain all employee records and keep resource planning systems up to date

Oliver Wyman Development:

  • Participate in project work within and adjacent to the broader Human Capital function on topics such as employee experience, retention, flexible working, utilization, performance, etc.
  • Organize own work and display ability to guide colleagues in building project deliverables
  • Work on cross-Practice Group, Market, Regional teams to deliver special / ad-hoc assignment in a collaborative manner
  • Be a firm citizen and embody Oliver Wyman values in day-to-day activities
  • Display a strong willingness to learn more about OW outside of the TM function by seeking out opportunities for broader involvement

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in a fast-paced and dynamic client services business environment
  • Management consulting and/or Human Resources experience preferred

Skills and Attributes:

  • Proven ability to establish and grow relationships at all levels within an organization
  • Credible, highly professional, able to communicate and negotiate effectively while managing diverse personalities, cultures and backgrounds
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor the message to fit the audience
  • Self-motivated and proactive; someone who takes full ownership of her/his work and is flexible to prioritize or reprioritize as needed
  • Comfortable working with data (excel, powerpoint and enterprise resource management software)
  • Creative, strategic thinker who continually seeks ways to improve processes
  • Genuinely interested in the development and career success of the consultants with whom you work
  • A strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy is required to juggle multiple projects and tasks simultaneously; as well as the ability to organize, prioritize and manage one’s day and schedule to effectively to meet deadlines
  • Comfortable working independently, but can thrive in a team setting; all while working in a fast-paced environment
  • English and Spanish Speaker

Oliver Wyman, a business of Marsh McLennan (NYSE: MMC), is a management consulting firm combining deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise to help clients optimize their business, improve operations and accelerate performance. Marsh McLennan is a global leader in risk, strategy and people, advising clients in 130 countries across four businesses: Marsh, Guy Carpenter, Mercer and Oliver Wyman. With annual revenue of $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues, Marsh McLennan helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh McLennan is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh McLennan is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh McLennan colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Operador de Podcast Pleno
description:
Descrição da Vaga: Operador(a) de Podcast e Transmissões ao Vivo (Pleno/Sênior)

Nota Importante: Vaga Exclusiva para Profissionais com Experiência Comprovada

Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para operadores de podcast com um portfólio sólido e experiência prática demonstrável. A proficiência em OBS Studio é fundamental para a função.

Buscamos um profissional já qualificado, que possa assumir a posição com autonomia imediata. A etapa final do processo seletivo consiste em um dia de operação real em nosso estúdio.

Esta vaga não se destina a estagiários, profissionais em início de carreira (juniores) ou em treinamento.

Sobre Nós

Somos o Otimize Estúdios, um estúdio profissional localizado na Av. Angélica, no coração de Higienópolis, em São Paulo. Especializados na gravação de podcasts e cursos de alta qualidade, oferecemos uma infraestrutura de ponta para criadores de conteúdo e empresas.

Sua Missão no Otimize Estúdios

Como Operador(a) Pleno, você será a autoridade técnica responsável por garantir a execução impecável de nossas gravações e transmissões ao vivo. Sua missão é traduzir o planejamento em uma operação sem falhas, utilizando sua expertise para resolver problemas em tempo real e entregar um produto audiovisual de máxima qualidade aos nossos clientes.

Suas Responsabilidades

  • Operação Técnica de Ponta a Ponta: Conduzir gravações e transmissões ao vivo de podcasts utilizando OBS Studio como plataforma principal.
  • Setup e Calibração: Configurar e otimizar o setup completo de áudio, vídeo e iluminação antes de cada sessão.
  • Gerenciamento em Tempo Real: Gerenciar múltiplas fontes, transições e mídias durante as transmissões, garantindo uma execução fluida.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Monitorar ativamente a qualidade da transmissão, realizando ajustes imediatos e solucionando imprevistos técnicos com agilidade.
  • Pré-edição e Organização: Realizar cortes básicos e organizar os arquivos gravados, preparando-os de forma eficiente para a pós-produção.
  • Manutenção de Equipamentos: Zelar pela manutenção preventiva e calibração periódica de todos os equipamentos do estúdio.

Qualificações e Experiência

Requisitos Essenciais:

  • Domínio Avançado de OBS Studio: Sua proficiência é o pilar desta vaga e será validada na prática.
  • Experiência Comprovada: Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência na operação técnica de podcasts profissionais ou produções ao vivo similares.
  • Portfólio Robusto e Obrigatório: Apresentação de um portfólio que demonstre claramente sua experiência e a qualidade técnica dos projetos que operou.
  • Conhecimento Profundo em Áudio: Experiência prática com mesas de som, microfones, interfaces e técnicas de mixagem em tempo real.
  • Habilidade em Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade comprovada para diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos sob pressão.

Diferenciais (Qualificações Desejáveis):

  • Conhecimento em vMix: Embora nossa ferramenta de operação atual seja o OBS Studio, a experiência com vMix será considerada um forte diferencial.
  • Experiência com softwares de edição de vídeo (Adobe Premiere Pro) e áudio (Adobe Audition).
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de iluminação de estúdio para vídeo.

Perfil Comportamental que Buscamos

  • Dono do Processo: Assume a responsabilidade pela qualidade técnica e se dedica a entregar o melhor resultado.
  • Pontualidade e Confiabilidade: Sua equipe e nossos clientes confiam que tudo estará pronto e funcionando no horário combinado.
  • Proatividade e Antecipação: Você não espera o problema acontecer; você o antecipa e já tem um plano B.

Condições da Vaga

  • Modelo de Contratação: CLT.
  • Jornada: Segunda a Sexta-feira, 44 horas semanais.
  • Local de Trabalho: Presencial em nosso estúdio em Higienópolis, São Paulo - SP.
  • Remuneração: Salário competitivo de mercado, mais benefícios.

Nosso Processo Seletivo

  • Análise Curricular e de Portfólio: Avaliação criteriosa das suas experiências e dos trabalhos apresentados.
  • Entrevista Técnica: Conversa aprofundada com os líderes da área.
  • Teste Prático Imersivo: O candidato finalista participará de um dia de operação real em nosso estúdio, conduzindo a gravação de um podcast. Esta etapa remunerada é fundamental para validarmos sua habilidade técnica na prática.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Backend Developer - Lyric

You will start your day on a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goal with your team. You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.

Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre/RS Office location.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silos. You'll talk to everyone, from the project manager to the Quality Assurance Analyst and current customers, to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Strong backend development experience, preferably with NodeJS;
  • Knowledge of best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, being able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.
  • Participates in requirements gathering and reviews, assesses technical feasibility, assists in defining solutions, and prepares development artifacts where required.
  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology; remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards; trains technical staff on new technologies.
  • Advanced English;

HOW YOU’LL STAND OUT:

  • Nice to have, develop frontend framework for other teams
  • If you could also develop frontend web applications using ReactJS
  • Support production software operations, test and debug programs
  • Make a good use of the CI and CD pipeline
  • Self-taught worker: capable of learning and applying by himself
  • Self-guided worker: capable of working with different product teams with little supervision after the initial learning period
  • Strong collaboration skills: ability to establish good relationships with the stakeholders
  • Developer empathy: ability to empathize with developers, by being flexible in solution design without compromising best practices and standards.
  • Improvisation (lateral thinking): the ability to think across disciplines and existing boundaries (technologies/business/geographies)
  • Research: an inclination to continuous research inside and outside of the current focus fields.

Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

"Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo no 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador"

  • Mantém informações detalhadas sobre restaurantes, lojas, serviços de entrega e outros pontos de interesse locais, além de manter relacionamento com fornecedores de serviços de concierge.

CONHECIMENTOS BÁSICOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz com potenciais clientes, residentes, fornecedores e colegas de trabalho.

  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e atenção aos detalhes, para produzir documentos sem erros e criar sistemas e processos organizados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente, para interagir com diversos perfis de pessoas, manter a calma sob pressão e oferecer suporte com simpatia.
  • Ensino Médio completo, GED (certificado de equivalência) ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.

VIAGENS / DEMANDAS FÍSICAS:

  • Os membros da equipe trabalham em um ambiente de escritório ou de forma remota. Não há exigências físicas especiais.
  • Viagens raras ou ocasionais podem ser necessárias para participar de reuniões de negócios, treinamentos ou outras situações importantes para a realização das atividades diárias do cargo.

A Greystar é uma empresa global líder, totalmente integrada, do setor imobiliário, com expertise em gestão de propriedades, gestão de investimentos, desenvolvimento e serviços de construção nos setores de habitação para aluguel, logística e ciências da vida. Com sede em Charleston, Carolina do Sul (EUA), a Greystar administra e opera mais de 290 bilhões de dólares em imóveis em 247 mercados globais, com escritórios na América do Norte, Europa, América do Sul e região Ásia-Pacífico.

A Greystar é a maior operadora de apartamentos nos Estados Unidos, gerenciando mais de 857.400 unidades/leitos globalmente. title: Lavador de Veiculos Automotivo (linha Pesadas)
description:

Na Unidas, acreditamos que carreira é jornada, não destino. Somos um dos maiores grupos do Brasil no setor de mobilidade e terceirização de frotas, com soluções completas que vão de veículos leves a pesados, passando por máquinas e equipamentos. Mas o que realmente nos move são as pessoas.

A Unidas integra o portfólio da Brookfield Asset Management, uma das maiores gestoras de ativos do mundo, com visão de longo prazo e compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável.

title: ANALISTA PLANEJAMENTO FINANCEIRO SR - AFIRMATIVA PARA MULHERES

title: ASSISTENTE ADMNINISTRATIVO TI
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Prestar suporte à gestão financeira e administrativa da TI, garantindo a organização, o controle e a conformidade de todos os processos que envolvem pedidos de compra, contratos, orçamentos e despesas da área, bem como atuando no planejamento do orçamento anual da área e otimização de alocação de recursos, garantindo em todos os processos a governança e o alinhamento com as normas e procedimentos da empresa.

  • Participar ativamente do processo de planejamento orçamentário anual (Opex e Capex) da área;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de apresentações e relatórios gerenciais;

A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

As a Software Engineer II (Analyst), you will be responsible for automating repetitive tasks, streamlining the software development lifecycle, and optimizing deployment processes to enable faster and more reliable software releases. You will analyze existing engineering processes and workflows to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement. With guild insights you will collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement process improvements, optimize code review processes, and implement continuous integration and delivery best practices.

In this position, you will work remotely with Teachable’s Brazil and US-based teams. We are hiring talented engineers in Brazil.

This position is hybrid to our São Paulo office. Although flexible, local employees tend to use our São Paulo office 1-2 times a week.

Additionally, this position will collaborate with American employees on a daily basis, so fluency in English is required.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications
  • Proficiency in using Golang or Ruby in a production environment in a backend or fullstack capacity
  • Excitement and motivation to expand your skillset and take on difficult challenges
  • Team player mentality: highly collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving

Nice to have:

  • Experience on an engineering enablement or platform team or experience contributing engineering-wide initiatives
  • Experience working on a platform with multiple services
  • Experience working on product teams where you built and shipped features to customers partnering with design and product management
  • DevOps or SRE experience utilizing tools such as docker, kubernetes, terraform

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: 3D CGI Artist, Specialist
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a talented Designer / CGI Artist to join our dynamic global brand team. You will be responsible for creating visually stunning, high-quality CGI assets that elevate our campaigns and digital content. The ideal candidate is a creative thinker with a keen eye for detail, exceptional design skills, and a passion for pushing the boundaries of digital storytelling.

Key Responsibilities

  • CGI Asset Creation: Design and produce high-quality CGI content for product visuals, marketing campaigns, and digital experiences.
  • Design Collaboration: Work closely with the design team and external agencies to develop creative assets that align with the brand’s vision and standards.
  • Visual Storytelling: Bring products to life through compelling CGI renders, animations, and 3D visualizations.
  • Creative Ideation: Contribute ideas for campaign concepts and visual strategies, with a focus on innovative and trend-forward design solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Work: Collaborate with global marketing, social media, CX, and product teams to ensure cohesive brand representation across channels.
  • Quality Assurance: Review and refine CGI assets to meet brand guidelines and project specifications.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay updated on the latest trends in CGI, digital art, and design to keep our content cutting-edge.
  • Asset Management: Maintain organized files and manage the library of CGI assets for efficient access and use.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5-7 years of experience as a CGI Artist, 3D Designer, or related role in a creative agency or in-house brand team.
  • Technical Skills: Expertise in CGI software such as Cinema 4D, Blender, Maya, or similar programs. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite is essential.
  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing high-quality CGI work, 3D visualizations, and relevant design projects.
  • Creative Skills: Strong artistic ability with a deep understanding of composition, color, lighting, and storytelling.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to troubleshoot technical challenges and propose creative solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent collaboration and communication skills (English fluency); able to take direction and contribute effectively within a global team.
  • Detail-Oriented: Keen attention to detail, ensuring every project meets the highest quality standards.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and handling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Digital Arts, or a related field preferred.

title: Software Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Software Architect who wants to learn and transform his career.

Visão Geral:

  • O Arquiteto de Sistemas é responsável por analisar requisitos, projetar a estrutura do sistema, seja on-premise ou em nuvem, orientar a equipe técnica, avaliar tecnologias e garantir a qualidade do sistema. Ele assegura que o sistema seja eficiente, escalável e seguro, alinhando-se às necessidades do negócio, e de acordo com a estratégia corporativa, padrões técnicos e tecnológicos corporativos. O Arquiteto de Sistemas atua próximo ao time de desenvolvimento e ao time de Arquitetura de Soluções.

Responsabilidades:

  • Projeta a arquitetura das aplicações a partir da especificação de arquitetura de soluções e de negócio.
  • Seguir os padrões de integração e desenvolvimento, bem como de ferramentas necessárias ao desenvolvimento e manutenção dos sistemas.
  • Antecipar e avaliar tendências e produtos de TI, realizando contínua prospecção de tecnologias emergentes.
  • Apoiar a avaliação de como novos releases de tecnologias deverão ser implementados.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de planos de transição, implementação e estratégias de descontinuidade, assim como a definição e documentação da estrutura e a forma do sistema.
  • Apoiar a entrega de projetos, orientando-se para a padronização e aderência das soluções aos princípios e padrões da arquitetura corporativa.
  • Apoiar a elaboração das estratégias que viabilizem o atendimento aos requisitos não-funcionais das soluções (performance, disponibilidade e escalabilidade das aplicações).
  • Transferir conhecimento tecnológico para equipes de desenvolvimento.
  • Revisar e aprovar a arquitetura dos sistemas do negócio, destacando riscos e impactos técnicos.
  • Prover o suporte necessário às equipes de desenvolvimento na modelagem e/ou especificação das Arquiteturas de Aplicação;
  • Participar na seleção e aprovação de novas soluções e realizar provas de conceito para a homologação das novas tecnologias, serviços e soluções compartilhadas como oportunidades de evoluções para os assuntos conduzidos pela comunidade.
  • Definir de forma macro a solução de criação ou evolução do produto, em linha com as restrições do plano de sistemas observando todos os normativos pertinentes a segurança e qualidade, e os requisitos descritos em relatórios gerados pela equipe de Segurança.
  • Realizar cálculo do consumo de recursos computacionais e volumetria em tempo de upstream da criação do produto.
  • Apoiar os times de desenvolvimento em sessões de refinamento técnico.
  • Realizar análise de impacto nas mudanças nos sistemas.
  • Auxiliar as áreas de negócio a entenderem as suas necessidades e ajudar na priorização de projetos para defender a demanda no comitê de TI quando necessário. Habilidades e Qualificações

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos na área de arquitetura de sistemas, incluindo experiência em cloud computing com AWS
  • Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas complexos
  • Habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe

Hard skills:

  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software/ sistemas, incluindo:
  • Design patterns
  • Padrões de arquitetura
  • Metodologias de desenvolvimento de software
  • Soluções em nuvem
  • Bancos de dados
  • Domínio de Java 11 ou 17 e pelo menos mais uma das linguagens de programação a seguir: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#
  • Conhecimento em soluções serverless
  • Conhecimento de técnicas e estratégias de código (Git, Gitflow)
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de DevOps (CI, CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados (modelamento de bases, DML, DDL)
  • Conhecimento em APIs
  • Conhecimento em diagramas UML2
  • Conhecimento em diagramas C4
  • Conhecimento em criação de soluções em nuvem (AWS)
  • Desejável conhecimento em diagramas TOGAF

Competências comportamentais:

  • Além das competências técnicas, o Arquiteto de Sistemas deve possuir as seguintes competências comportamentais:
  • Comunicação: o arquiteto deve ser capaz de comunicar suas ideias de forma clara, objetiva e concisa, de forma oral e escrita. Isso inclui a capacidade de comunicar com diferentes públicos, como técnicos, não-técnicos e executivos, utilizando-se de diferentes formas de exposição de ideias, como texto, gráficos, diagramas, apresentações.
  • Inovação: o arquiteto deve ser capaz de pensar fora da caixa e propor soluções inovadoras. Isso inclui a capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhoria e de implementar novas tecnologias.

Habilidades interpessoais:

  • O Arquiteto de Soluções deve possuir as seguintes habilidades interpessoais:
  • Resolução de problemas: o arquiteto deve ser capaz de resolver problemas complexos de forma eficaz. Isso inclui a capacidade de identificar a causa do problema, desenvolver e implementar a solução.
  • Trabalhar em equipe: o arquiteto deve ser capaz de trabalhar em equipe de forma eficaz. Isso inclui a capacidade de colaborar com outros, compartilhar ideias e construir consenso.
  • Adaptabilidade: o arquiteto deve ser capaz de se adaptar a mudanças e desafios. Isso inclui a capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos rapidamente e de se adaptar a novas situações

title: Events Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Events Specialist to spearhead our presence and engagement initiatives within the local market. This role is crucial in building and nurturing strong relationships with key organizations, particularly shopping malls and local businesses, to drive brand visibility, foster community ties, and support our strategic objectives, including the growth of the SHEIN Marketplace. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, a meticulous planner, and a proactive relationship builder with a proven track record in event management and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key external organizations, including shopping malls, local businesses, industry associations, and community groups.
  • Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that align with SHEIN's regional goals and brand values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact and ambassador for SHEIN in regional interactions, ensuring consistent brand messaging and positive representation.

Event Planning & Execution:

  • Design, plan, and execute a diverse portfolio of regional events, activations, and promotional projects, often in collaboration with other partners.
  • Oversee all logistical aspects of events, including venue selection, vendor coordination, staffing, permits, and materials.
  • Ensure all events are meticulously organized, on-brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for attendees and partners.

Budget Management & Optimization:

  • Develop, manage, and meticulously track budgets for all events and partnership initiatives, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial guidelines.
  • Negotiate contracts with vendors and partners to secure favorable terms and maximize ROI.
  • Provide regular financial reporting and analysis on event expenditures.

Regional Representation & Communication:

  • Represent SHEIN at regional industry events, meetings, and community gatherings, networking effectively to enhance brand perception and uncover new opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver compelling presentations about SHEIN's initiatives (e.g., Marketplace, new campaigns) to various external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and promotion of regional activities.

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, such as setting up stands, events, or joint marketing campaigns with shopping malls / industry associations.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, and implement solutions to challenges that arise during planning or execution.

Reporting & Analysis:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all events and partnerships, providing comprehensive post-event reports and insights.
  • Utilize data to evaluate the success of initiatives and inform future strategy development.

Local Travel:

  • Frequent local travel within the designated region will be required to attend meetings and oversee event execution.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Event Management, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 5 years of proven experience in event management, community relations, and/or partnership development, preferably within retail, e-commerce, or a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and optimizing resources for events.
  • Strong track record of building and nurturing successful relationships with diverse organizations and stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, from conception to completion.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to deliver engaging presentations.
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and adapt to a dynamic work environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, Mandarin and/or English.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the e-commerce or fashion retail industry.
  • Familiarity with the regional market landscape, including key shopping centers and local organizations.
  • Experience presenting to large groups or external partners.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

description:

A iGlu Warm Technologies nasceu para transformar um mercado historicamente frio e arcaico: a tecnologia para o varejo físico no Brasil.

Se você quer fazer parte de um time com alto potencial de impacto, grandes desafios e onde será constantemente instigado a entregar seu melhor, junte-se à iGlu e ajude a transformar o futuro do varejo!

### Habilidades essenciais para jogar nesta posição

  • Alta capacidade de raciocínio lógico e sistêmico: você é capaz de mapear fluxos complexos entre ERPs, Ecommerces e outros sistemas e antecipar problemas antes que eles aconteçam.
  • Foco em resultado, não em tasks: Você prioriza entregas que impactam diretamente métricas de negócio, comparando constantemente seus resultados com suas metas.
  • Experiência profunda em desenvolvimento de sistemas backend: você tem grande familiaridade e track record de construção de backend a ponto de ter desenvolvido um bom senso para balancear engenharia e produto.
  • Engenheiro(a) com mentalidade de produto: você não escreve código só por escrever; entende profundamente as dores dos usuários e busca soluções que realmente façam diferença na vida deles. Você conecta engenharia e produto, propondo alternativas, simplificando fluxos e ajudando o time a tomar decisões que maximizem impacto.
  • Curiosidade e aplicação prática em AI: você tem interesse genuíno em como inteligência artificial pode gerar valor no varejo, seja na automação de processos, na análise de dados ou na criação de experiências inteligentes para os clientes. Mais do que buzzwords, você busca usar AI de forma pragmática e aplicável no produto.
  • Comunicação clara e transparente: nós valorizamos muito uma comunicação aberta e transparente, e vemos clareza na comunicação escrita e verbal como uma habilidade fundamental para a execução do trabalho de engenharia.
  • Aprendizado e domínio de programação funcional/Elixir: nossa stack de backend é construída em Elixir. Você não precisa chegar sabendo, mas precisa ter interesse genuíno em aprender rapidamente e dominar a linguagem, já que será através dela que você desenvolverá as soluções para nossos clientes.

### Suas missões mais frequentes

  • Participar do discovery técnico: antes de desenvolver, você ajuda a garantir que estamos construindo a solução certa do jeito mais simples e eficiente possível.
  • Construir componentes críticos para o produto: desenvolver APIs, soluções de arquitetura e serviços escaláveis que suportam o crescimento.
  • Integrar sistemas e automatizar processos: criar soluções que conectam ERPs, e-commerces e outros sistemas, viabilizando fluxos omni e aumentando a eficiência operacional.
  • Monitorar, otimizar e corrigir rápido: garantir estabilidade, corrigir bugs críticos e atuar em incidentes quando necessário – velocidade importa, qualidade também.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Leased Line / Private Line / Data Connectivity Services

We’re seeking an experienced Project Manager to take ownership of delivering complex leased line and private line connectivity projects across multiple carriers and geographies. This role requires someone who thrives on coordination, problem-solving, and hands-on delivery, ensuring that critical infrastructure projects are completed on time and to the highest standard.

This is not a desk-only job — you’ll be directly involved in coordinating suppliers, resolving on-site bottlenecks, and working across borders to deliver mission-critical connectivity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver multi-carrier physical connectivity projects (MPLS, EVPL, IEPL, submarine cable).
  • Map physical topologies and supplier demarcation points, ensuring clear ownership boundaries.
  • Coordinate and escalate with suppliers, driving accountability across complex delivery chains.
  • Handle on-site execution challenges, including access, permits, and construction issues.
  • Manage cross-border or international deliveries, including licensing and multi-country coordination.
  • Act as a trusted customer-facing representative, managing expectations, providing updates, and handling escalations.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Proven track record in delivering leased line / data connectivity projects.
  • Experience with MPLS backbone and local loop delivery, EVPL rollouts, or submarine cable projects.
  • Skilled at coordinating multiple suppliers, contractors, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong customer-facing and negotiation skills, with the ability to apply pressure and resolve conflicts pragmatically.
  • Street-smart problem-solver with a focus on delivery, not theory.
  • Hands-on mindset — willing to step in directly to resolve bottlenecks.

Ideal Background:

  • Mid-sized WAN service providers or organisations managing third-party leased-line delivery.
  • Cross-border connectivity projects and multi-carrier integrations.
  • Roles such as Delivery Manager, Implementation Lead, Service Delivery Coordinator, or Carrier Manager.

Not the Right Fit

  • Purely technical engineers (unless shifting into project delivery).
  • Enterprise IT end-users.
  • Senior architects or directors who are not hands-on with delivery.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to lead highly visible connectivity projects that span borders and deliver real impact. You’ll work at the cutting edge of global connectivity - managing the delivery of infrastructure that underpins international business and communication.

If you’re a hands-on project manager with strong multi-carrier coordination experience and a passion for problem-solving, we’d love to hear from you.

Fazer parte de um time global que incentiva inovação e criatividade, em um ambiente onde a multidisciplinaridade se destaca. Aqui, diferentes perspectivas se unem para desenvolver soluções que revolucionam o mercado automotivo e a experiência do cliente. Cada ideia é valorizada e todos têm a chance de transformar o futuro. Se você busca projetos desafiadores e disruptivos, a KAVAK é o seu lugar.

Missão dessa posição:

Desenvolver, criar e implementar estratégias comerciais para impulsionar os dois principais movimentos do negócio: compra (ampliação da base de fornecedores e captação de veículos por meio de lojistas e concessionárias) e venda (expansão da rede de clientes, fidelização de parceiros e distribuição consultiva dos veículos). Atuar de forma estratégica e relacional, garantindo equilíbrio entre aquisição e comercialização, fortalecendo o ecossistema e gerando crescimento sustentável para a empresa.

Descrição de Atividades:

  • Prospectar e Desenvolver Parcerias B2B :

Identificar e estabelecer relações comerciais com empresas fornecedoras de veículos (locadoras, frotistas, concessionárias, dealers, plataformas, entre outros).

  • Negociação Comercial:

Conduzir negociações para aquisição de veículos em condições competitivas.

  • Gestão de Pipeline:

Manter e atualizar o pipeline de oportunidades de compras e vendas de veículos.

  • Operação:

Responsável por conduzir a operação de compras internamente, contato com áreas de (Pricing, Tesouraria, Fiscal, Logística, etc).

Requisitos para candidatura:

  • Formação em Administração, Economia, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em negociações B2B e relacionamento com clientes corporativos;
  • Conhecimento de análise de preços e estratégias de mercado;
  • Domínio de Excel para elaboração de relatórios e análises;
  • Inglês ou Espanhol será um diferencial.

Habilidades que buscamos:

  • Capacidade de negociação clara e objetiva, tanto verbal quanto escrita, com diferentes stakeholders;
  • Proatividade e motivação para alcançar metas, com visão estratégica para identificar oportunidades;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e lidar com diversas áreas da empresa de forma integrada;
  • Capacidade de gerenciar dados e processos de maneira precisa e eficiente, com respeito aos prazos estabelecidos.

O que a Kavak te proporciona:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica para você e seus dependentes
  • WellHub (GymPass):Nossa plataforma de bem-estar, que proporciona atividades físicas e cuidados com a saúde mental.
  • Vale-Refeição e/ou Alimentação: Crédito depositado no Cartão Flash, para você escolher onde e como utilizar.
  • Auxílio Mobilidade ou Vale Transporte: Flexibilidade para que você escolha o benefício que melhor se adapta ao seu dia a dia.
  • Estacionamento Gratuito no Local: Para quem prefere vir de carro, oferecemos estacionamento sem custo.
  • Transporte Fretado (sem desconto): Transporte fretado à disposição, proporcionando mais conforto e segurança no trajeto.
  • Seguro de Vida: Segurança adicional para você e sua família.
  • Amparo: Estaremos ao seu lado e de sua família quando estiverem lidando com uma perda. Auxiliando em todos os desafios administrativos, financeiros e emocionais decorrentes da perda de um ente querido.
  • Day Off de Aniversário: Celebre seu dia com uma folga exclusiva.
  • Empréstimo Consignado: Acesso facilitado a crédito com taxas mais baixas, ajudando no planejamento financeiro.
  • Incentivos a Idiomas (Nulinga): apoio para você investir no seu desenvolvimento com cursos de idiomas com descontos atrativos, ampliando seu potencial de comunicação.
  • Programa de Bônus Kavak: Recompensas com base em metas e performance, valorizando o seu esforço e dedicação.
  • Desconto para compra de carros: você pode escolher o carro seminovo ou usado dos seus sonhos, dentro do inventário da Kavak, com desconto exclusivo para Kavakes e ainda contar com 4 revisões a um valor simbólico, de acordo com nossa política vigente.

Modelo de trabalho e local:

  • Local de Trabalho: Kavak City - Barueri - SP.

Sobre a Kavak

A Kavak traz ao mercado um modelo de negócios pioneiro que compreende a compra e venda online e serviços para veículos seminovos e usados, proporcionando uma experiência transparente e segura. No Brasil desde 2021, está presente também no México, Argentina, Chile, Turquia e Oriente Médio propondo a transformação no setor automotivo por meio de tecnologia e inovação. A Kavak se tornou a primeira empresa unicórnio da história do México e, atualmente, é uma das startups mais valiosas da América Latina.

title: Vendedor(a) Externo - Pronta Entrega - Obrigatório CNH C, D ou E

title: Principal Installation Analysis Engineer 25003289
description:
Job Overview:

The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex Installation Analysis-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Installation Analysis. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in Installation Analysis as well as broad knowledge of the Installation Analysis discipline within the Engineering function.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Apply in-depth skills and broad knowledge of the business to address complex problems and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and - procedures
  • Manage own time to meet objectives and (as Lead Engineer) forecast and plan resource requirements
  • Communicate and explain difficult concepts and persuade others to adopt a point of view
  • When acting as Lead Engineer, in addition:
  • Direct an Engineering team as a Lead Engineer
  • Lead the Discipline engineering design of the assigned work area and complete it within the planned schedule and budget, in accordance with standards, MDR, and project-specific procedures and to a high professional standard
  • Plan, organize, and direct all aspects of Discipline execution on the assigned project including scope, deliverables, schedule, and all manpower resources - agree allocations with the Discipline Manager
  • Ensure interfaces and deliverables are clearly identified
  • Maintain responsibility for progress and productivity, identifying any required corrective action
  • Act as project representative for Discipline during meetings with the Project Team, Customer discipline lead, and relevant agencies such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.
  • Become fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address issues, interpreting contractual requirements as they relate to engineering execution
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for variation orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash-free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close coordination with other engineering disciplines, Planning, fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to Discipline Lead Engineer and Discipline Manager
  • Prepare estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and manhour estimates, identifying software requirements and any other project-specific requirements
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications
  • Participate in finalizing deliverable lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Review project schedule and fabrication schedule in relation to construction sequence, milestones, and engineering scope
  • Attend project kickoff and review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve design reports and procedures
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • Assist procurement personnel in procuring discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with Customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing, reviewing, and (as Lead Engineer) approving requisitions, evaluating technical quotations, and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve vendor and subcontractor submittals, checking for compliance with project specifications and providing comments as necessary
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve design verification through single-discipline check /inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Discipline Manager and Project Management Team apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Check final subcontractor and vendor data manuals to ensure that all requested data has been received and approved
  • Present issues and problems to Customers in a timely manner and assist the Lead Engineer in negotiating resolution in accordance with project and company requirements
  • Perform (as required) Technical Quality Audit reviews in accordance with MDR Global Procedures
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Supervise and guide assigned engineers and coordinate with Lead Designers for Discipline engineering and design deliverables
  • Responsible for the engineering integrity of the assigned work area
  • Monitor costs of own work processes
  • Assist in the maintenance of departmental technical guidelines and standard calculation notes
  • Participate in development and maintenance of Global Procedures, Software, and Standards
  • May participate in standards development committees or task groups such as API
  • Develop communication and presentation skills (e.g., write technical papers, participate in conferences and/or seminars, present design solutions, and/or present topics at ‘lunch and learn’; etc.)
  • Identify and provide training to staff in specific techniques and proprietary software
  • Provide information on employee performance to the Discipline Manager
  • Assist the Discipline manager in interviewing job applicants
  • Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Pipeline Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids):
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Structural Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids) of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • When acting as Lead engineer, in addition:
  • Act as project-based discipline point of contact in communications and meetings with customer counterparts
  • Ensure substantive communications are documented
  • Prepare bids and projects discipline engineering budget and execution plans
  • Identify project staff needs based on knowledge of individual engineer’s skill sets and provide requests to the discipline manager
  • Plan, organize, and assign tasks, responsibilities, and manhour budgets to the discipline team, and verify tasks are completed within budgets
  • Plan discipline deliverable schedule/register compliant with the overall execution plan
  • Prepare work forecasts identifying change management plans, corrective action, and real-time schedule
  • Provide discipline inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master’s is a preference)
  • 15-20 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Detailed knowledge of design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the theory, content, and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable Knowledgeable in project coordination and execution skills
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
Location: São Paulo, Brazil | Reports to: VP & GM, Americas

Why Join Us

GigaDevice Semiconductor is one of the world’s fastest-growing semiconductor companies and a global leader in SPI NOR Flash and a top 10 global provider of 32-bit MCUs. With a rapidly expanding portfolio that now includes NOR Flash, ARM and RISC-V based MCUs, sensors, PMUs, and niche DRAM, we serve high-growth markets including automotive, industrial, IoT, consumer electronics, and computing.

In Brazil, we are committed to building a stronger presence and winning share in a highly dynamic and competitive market. As a Field Application Engineer (FAE) based in Brazil, you will be responsible for providing technical support to customers designing with GigaDevice’s non-volatile memories, microcontrollers, power devices, and sensors. You will work closely with the sales and marketing team to drive technical discussions, convert design-ins into design-wins, and strengthen our position in the region. This role is critical not only in supporting current products but also in shaping future product development by working with customers, engineering, and technical marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support to customers both on-site and virtually.
  • Engage with customers to thoroughly understand their design requirements, identify additional projects, and capture new business opportunities across product lines.
  • Serve as the primary technical driver for design-in to design-win conversion, providing pre- and post-sales technical support.
  • Deliver technical training to customers, partners, and distributors
  • Understand the product landscape in the field and gather competitive and market intelligence
  • Develop application notes and contribute to product qualification activities.
  • Maintain strong technical expertise, particularly in embedded systems and MCU products
  • Travel within Brazil (and occasionally to other Latin American markets) to ensure GigaDevice maintains a strong presence.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in the electronics industry, with a focus on Arm Cortex-M based microcontroller products; familiarity with RISC-V ISA is a plus.
  • Strong ability to read, understand, and develop C/C++ code for Arm microcontrollers.
  • Knowledge of operating systems such as FreeRTOS.
  • Proficiency with IDE tools including Keil uVision v5 and IAR Embedded Workbench.
  • Ability to read electronic design schematics, use measurement instruments, and familiarity with EDA tools.
  • Experience with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Motor Control solutions.
  • Independent, analytical, and self-motivated with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to travel regionally to support customers.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English; Spanish a plus.
  • High integrity, proactive, results-driven, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical field. Master’s degree preferred; other technical or business degrees considered with relevant experience.

title: IB MYP Mathematics Teacher
description:

Main responsibilities within the role:
